headline: Discovery call execution framework: 5 email templates + call tracker + 30-min playbook. Ready to conduct 5+ warm-outreach calls.
highlights: 5 production-ready email templates (Template 1: Warm Intro High Intent, Template 2: Gentle Re-Engagement, Template 3: Pilot Offer, Template 4: Objection Reframe, Template 5: Multi-Touch Opener)
Van Westendorp WTP tracker with 4-anchor ladder ($2K, $4.8K, $24K, $36K) + aggregate synthesis for 5+ calls
30-minute call structure: Warmup → Current State → Value Prop → Van Westendorp → Objections → Pilot Intent → Close
Objection library with quick counters (color accuracy, vendor lock-in, multi-brand support, timeline concerns)
Post-call logging template capturing verbatim quotes on speed, fidelity, fulfillment quality
Success metrics: 5+ calls, ≥60% pilot intent, top 3 objection themes identified, 2–3 pilots in pipeline
Call quality checklist (70/30 listen/talk ratio, 4 WTP anchors captured, clear next steps)
